description: Currency converter (ECB reference rates): convert an amount from one currency to one or more others, e.g. 250 USD to EUR, GBP and JPY, at the latest European Central Bank rate or any day in the last 90 days. Returns the rate, converted amount and rate date for each target. 30 currencies. Reference rates, not transaction rates. Source: ECB. Signed receipt. Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"from":"USD","to":"EUR,GBP,JPY","amount":"250"}.

date.description: Rate date YYYY-MM-DD within the last 90 days; default latest

name: fx_convert

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Converted amounts and rates per target currency at the ECB rate date

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: Currency Converter (ECB)
